questions.question_description:
Labor migration: Labor migration is defined as the movement of persons from their native place to other place within or outside the country for the purpose of employment within the country or outside the country.
Pastoralism: Social organization based on livestock raising as the primary economic activity.
Displacement due to disaster: Situations where people are forced to leave their homes or places of habitual residence as a result of a disaster or in order to avoid the impact of an immediate and foreseeable climate/natural hazard.
Planned evacuation: Planned evacuation is the immediate egress or escape of people away from an area that contains an imminent threat due to natural hazard/climate induced disasters, an ongoing threat or a hazard to lives or property.
